remediationGuidance: Do not add a new D1 table solely for quota coordination unless an implementation constraint disproves reuse of s2_infrastructure_checks.
Generalize the existing claim/readback idiom instead of duplicating a second quota subsystem.
Keep one shared account-level gate module callable by warmup, Daily Shadow physical persistence, historical annual writer and other high-write System2 workflows.
Push-triggered Recent A1 warmup must remain non-physical regardless of quota headroom.
Use account analytics if already authorized; otherwise fail/defer discretionary high-write work conservatively without asking for new permission.
Keep receipts compact so quota governance itself cannot become a material quota consumer.
